pages.draftNotice: Ejam Kopā is still being built. This page is updated whenever the site starts storing something new.

about.title: About Ejam Kopā
about.lead: Ejam Kopā helps you find people to do things with. Here is what we believe in.

awkward.title: Reaching out made easier
awkward.text: Reaching out to strangers is awkward, whether you are looking for a group or for members. We want to make it easier.

groups.title: Groups come first
groups.text: Create a group, get found, join and talk. Events belong to groups.

glance.title: Clear at a glance
glance.text: Colour shows the category, and you see the city and the number of members right away.

calm.title: Calm
calm.text: No endless feed and nothing built to keep you on the screen. Find your people and meet in real life.

honest.title: Honest
honest.text: We only show what already works.

nonprofit.title: Non-profit
nonprofit.text: No ads. Starting in Latvia, in Latvian and English, one step at a time.

privacy.cookies1: A sign-in session cookie keeps you logged in, and a language cookie remembers your language. Both are needed for the site to work.
privacy.cookies2: Your browser also stores a small note that you dismissed the cookie banner.
privacy.cookies3: We do not use advertising or third-party analytics, and we do not sell data.
privacy.data1: Your account: name, email address, and a password (stored only as a one-way hash). If you sign in with Google or GitHub, we receive your name, email address and profile picture from them.
privacy.data2: Your profile: username, optional bio, cities, and your privacy choices (whether your profile is public, whether people may message you, and whether it lists your groups).
privacy.data3: What you do on the site: groups you create or join, posts, direct messages, event RSVPs, notifications, and reports you file.
privacy.intro: This page describes what Ejam Kopā actually stores and why. It is written in plain language.
privacy.rights1: You can edit your profile at any time. Deleting your account from within the site is not available yet.
privacy.rights2: To see, correct or delete your data, write to <mail>ejam@lumm.eu</mail>. Requests are handled by hand for now.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.visibility1: Public groups, their public events and public profiles can be seen by anyone. Members-only content is shown only to members.
privacy.visibility2: Messages are stored on our server and are not end-to-end encrypted.
